remarks: Welcome home to 87 Glenbrook, a secure elevator building ideally located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This bright corner unit features an open-concept layout, and an abundance of natural light throughout. Enjoy the comfort of a spacious, immaculate home complete with beautiful parquet hardwood floors and generous closet space.  Relax and unwind on your private balcony-perfect for enjoying warmer days and evenings. Conveniently situated within walking distance to shops, restaurants, and everyday essentials, and just minutes from I-95 and Metro-North for an easy commute.  Additional highlights include reserved off-street parking (Space #45), on-site laundry, and rent that includes heat (up to 55 degrees) and hot water. The unit has already been freshly painted and two windows outfitted with new blinds. The unit will be professionally cleaned prior to the new tenant's move-in.
